div.div: Five CHECK constraints hold the business rules in the database as well as in the application, so a rule survives a view that forgets it. Two UNIQUE constraints keep each chain of signed records linear, so no record can be the predecessor of two others. The data model draws all seven.

div.div:
Where the project stands today
The application runs locally: docker compose up -d provides the PostgreSQL 17 node, and manage.py runserver the application server. The two are already separate processes speaking the protocol drawn above, so moving to a hosted server changes the address and not the design. Compose also starts a pgAdmin container for looking at the database; it is a tool for reading the system, not a part of it, so it is not drawn as a node.
Deployment is the subject of Sprint 4, which is when the course covers it, and a WSGI server arrives with it.
Every version named here is the version installed, read from pip list and from the image tags in docker-compose.yml. It is deliberately not read from requirements.txt, which states the lowest version accepted rather than the one in use.
